CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (p0/current/n0 red), an organization/origin entry, and a separate identity line are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing-condition phrase linking to content presentation or access is present.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identity lines (color assignments to named referents) are present.

D.rationale: Identity (color coordinate) is presented separately from an origin/organization status for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are organized/presented (origin metadata, candidate/current inheritance and display layout).
